newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended unchanged at 41.35 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday and was likely to remain stable in the near term, dealers said.
"The rupee was unchanged as dollar supply matched the demand for it," one dealer said. "The rupee will stay stable as the dollar has weakened against most major currencies."
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, fixed on July 11, was at 40.5200/40.7226 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended unchanged at 2.0 percent.
